title: Just Unbreakable Shield
description: This data pack adds an unbreakable shield that is hard to craft but has a power equivalent to its difficulty of obtaining.
body:
This data pack adds an unbreakable shield that is hard to craft but has a power equivalent to its difficulty of obtaining.
This unbreakable shield gives an improved attack range up to 14 blocks and Fire Aspect 5 as long as you hold it in your main hand
